sections.overview: Leptothele bencha is a mygalomorph spider in the family Euagridae, described from Thailand.
sections.identification: A 2020 taxonomic study redescribed both sexes, complementing the original 1995 description.
sections.habitat: Documented localities span several southern Thai provinces and islands, including the type locality at Khao Phanom Bencha.
sections.diet: The taxonomic sources consulted do not give species-specific prey records.
sections.behavior: The reviewed accounts focus on morphology and distribution, leaving its behaviour poorly documented.
sections.reproduction: The 2020 redescription includes adult males and females but does not establish a detailed breeding cycle.
sections.ecology: The 2020 paper also describes the congener Leptothele chang, which it distinguishes as larger and paler; that species is not in the illustrated catalogue.
sections.conservation: No species-level conservation assessment was found in the taxonomic records consulted.

sources.title: New euagrid spiders and new localities of L. bencha — Revue suisse de Zoologie
